name: E00_2_dazzling_angel_another_creature_of_yours_only
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.' All three creatures are put onto the battlefield from the hand, none cast. The Angel itself enters first: 'another' leaves it out, so seat 0 stays at 20. Seat 0's Bear enters: 21. Seat 1's Bear enters under seat 1's control: it is not a creature seat 0 controls, so nobody gains: seat 0 21, seat 1 20.
